action: No action needed; for awareness. The LCSD says it is notifying affected users with the contractor and consulting the privacy commissioner and the Digital Policy Office.
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than the LCSD announcement of 25 November; the contractor told the LCSD on 24 November.

evidence.quote: 初步調查顯示，今次事故涉及約 130 萬名使用者的個人資料，受影響範疇包括用戶名稱／姓名、電話號碼及電郵地址。

exec: Hong Kong LCSD says its URBTIX ticketing system, run by a contractor, was illegally accessed.
geo_basis: agency HQ (Hong Kong, as the source states)
plain: Hong Kong Leisure and Cultural Services Department says the URBTIX ticketing system was illegally accessed.
summary: According to PCM, Hong Kong's Leisure and Cultural Services Department said on 25 November that the URBTIX contractor reported on 24 November that the system had been illegally accessed. Preliminary investigation shows the incident involves personal data of about 1.3 million users: user name or name, phone number and email address. The department says the system holds no ID document data and credit card data is masked.
title: Hong Kong LCSD says URBTIX ticketing system was hacked (duplicate record; PCM source)

validation.note: One publisher (PCM) read, relaying the LCSD announcement; the LCSD's own notice was not read.
